evals.prompt: Audit a PR whose committed CSS sets an h1 to 48px while inheriting a fixed 20px line-height. The unstaged diff is empty.
evals.expected_output: Inspect the PR branch diff and report the overlapping-line risk.
assertions: Does not conclude there is nothing to audit because the unstaged diff is empty
Names the inherited fixed line-height
Uses the rule-specific impact rather than the category default

evals.prompt: Audit code samples that contain straight quotes and a --no-input flag, beside rendered paragraph text.
evals.expected_output: Keep code punctuation verbatim and scope typography rules to rendered prose.
assertions: Does not replace quotes inside code
Does not alter --no-input
Limits punctuation findings to the rendered paragraph text

evals.prompt: Bold text on our blog looks smeared and the text pops in late on first load. Can you audit the font setup in site.css and post.html?
evals.expected_output: Report the single regular face behind the synthesized bold and italic, the missing font-display, and the stack with no fallbacks, each with a fix.
assertions: Identifies that the browser synthesizes bold because only a regular font file is loaded
Flags the missing font-display descriptor
Flags that the font-family value has no fallback fonts
Recommends loading real bold and italic font files or a variable font
Cites at least one rule ID that begins with font-

evals.prompt: Long pages in our docs feel tiring to read. Review the body text typography in docs.css (guide.html is a typical page).
evals.expected_output: Report the overlong measure, the tight paragraph line-height, the tracked body text, and the justified paragraphs, each with a fix.
assertions: Flags the prose line length as too long
Recommends a measure of roughly 45 to 75 characters per line
Flags the 1.2 line-height on paragraphs as too tight
Flags the letter-spacing applied to body paragraphs
Flags the justified paragraph text

evals.prompt: Copy check on landing.html before it goes live. Only the typography of the text itself: quotes, dashes, that kind of thing.
evals.expected_output: Report the straight quotes, the double hyphen, the hyphenated ranges, and the three-period ellipsis in rendered copy, leaving the command in the code block alone.
assertions: Flags the straight quotes around the testimonial
Flags the double hyphen in the hero heading
Recommends an en dash for the Mon-Fri or 9-5 range
Flags the three periods after Loading your workspace as needing an ellipsis character
Leaves the brightdesk import command inside the code element unchanged

evals.prompt: Design already signed off the terms page. Can you run a typography check on terms.html and legal.css and tell me if anything actually needs fixing before launch?
evals.expected_output: Confirm the font loading, measure, and punctuation are sound and report no critical finding.
assertions: Does not report synthesized bold or italic
Does not report a line-length problem
Does not report straight quotes or apostrophes in the copy
Reports no finding rated critical or launch-blocking
